notes.title: 🚀 Our Public Roadmap is Live! Come See What’s Coming to Cosmic Coop 🪐
notes.notes:
[p][/p][p]Hey spacefarmer![/p][p]Cosmic Coop is a game full of weird creatures, cozy chaos, and a surprising amount of strange NPCs. But guess what? We’re not done yet! 🛠️[/p][p]We’re a small team (okay, mostly just me, a few amazing freelancers that come and go, and some overworked critterlings) which means while we’ve packed in a lot of love, there’s still so much more we want to add.[/p][p][/p][p]🎯 That’s why we’ve made a public roadmap!
It shows what’s already in, what’s being worked on, and what wild features might land in the future.[/p][p][/p][p]👉 [b]Check it out here[/b]:
[url="https://trello.com/b/wnt0CGEo/cosmic-coop-roadmap"]Cosmic Coop - Roadmap Trello Board[/url][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h3]🚜 What You’ll Find:[/h3][list][*][p]Features coming soon👀[/p][/*][*][p]Bugs we’re taming negotiating with[/p][/*][*][p]Stuff we [i]really[/i] want to add if we can[/p][/*][*][p]Community suggestions (In the end, I want this to be a community driven game!)[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]💬 Want to help?[/h3][p]Your feedback = power-ups for this project. If there’s something you’d love to see in the game, feel free to leave a comment below or on the board.[/p][p]Thanks for being here early. Let’s grow this garden of chaos together! 🪴👾[/p][p]– Kyle & the Cosmic Critterlings[/p]
